title: Houthis close in on Aden as Yemeni forces dig in behind fortified line
description:
Iran-backed Houthi rebels have advanced to within about 60 kilometres of the seat of Yemen's internationally recognised government in the southern city of Aden, but the forces fighting them have set up a fortified line to defend the city, a military official said Tuesday.
Iran reiterated Tuesday that it would not hold talks with the United States to end their conflict unless several conditions are met. It also said three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite US aerial protection.
Meanwhile, at least nine Palestinians were killed in several Israeli strikes in Gaza, local officials said.
